length = int(input())
text = input().lower()

max_segment = -1
word_count = 0
parentheses_level = 0
underscore_seq = 0

for i in range(length):
    ch = text[i]
    if ch == '(':
        parentheses_level += 1
        underscore_seq = 0
    elif ch == ')':
        if parentheses_level == 1 and underscore_seq != 0:
            word_count += 1
        parentheses_level -= 1
        underscore_seq = 0
    elif ch == '_':
        if parentheses_level == 1 and underscore_seq != 0:
            word_count += 1
        underscore_seq = 0
    else:
        underscore_seq += 1
    if parentheses_level == 0:
        max_segment = max(underscore_seq, max_segment)

print(f"{max_segment} {word_count}")
